name: User Testimonials
author: Best WP Developer

sections.description:
Introducing the User Testimonials, a plugin designed for users of Elementor who are looking to add eye-catching testimonial sections to their websites. This plugin comes with over 14 beautifully designed layouts, making it easy to display customer reviews, feedback, and testimonials in a stylish and professional manner.

Testimonials are a crucial element for any business website as they help build trust, provide social proof, and highlight your brand’s success. User Testimonials helps you effortlessly add this valuable content to your site with just a few clicks. Whether you’re a freelancer, small business owner, or a large enterprise, this plugin will enhance your website by displaying customer testimonials in an engaging and visually appealing way.

The plugin is fully compatible with Elementor, allowing you to drag and drop widgets into your page and customize them according to your needs. With various styles and layout options, User Testimonials makes it possible to create a testimonial section that aligns with your brand’s aesthetics and conveys a message of credibility and trustworthiness.

Features

🔓 Free Version Features

  • ✅ 2 Unique Testimonial Designs – Choose from a variety of attractive layouts including grid, slider, and list styles.
  • ✅ Fully Compatible with Elementor – Drag-and-drop Elementor widgets for easy customization without any coding.
  • ✅ Responsive Layouts – All designs are mobile-friendly and look great on desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
  • ✅ Customizable Options – Adjust fonts, colors, spacing, borders, and more to match your site’s branding.
  • ✅ Lightweight and Optimized – Built for speed and performance without bloating your site.
  • ✅ Beginner-Friendly – Simple and intuitive interface suitable for all skill levels.
  • ✅ Regular Updates – Stay up-to-date with new features and compatibility improvements.
  • ✅ Completely Free – Enjoy essential features at no cost.

🔐 Pro Version Features

Get Pro
– 🚀 14+ Premium Testimonial Layouts – Access an extended collection of advanced, modern, and unique designs.
– ✨ Advanced Animation Effects – Add smooth transitions and hover effects for engaging testimonial displays.
– 🔧 More Styling Controls – Unlock advanced controls for detailed customization of every element.
– 🧩 Multiple Slider Settings – Choose autoplay, loop, navigation, speed, and other slider options.
– 📁 Category-wise Filtering – Display testimonials by category for better organization and user experience.
– 🌐 Third-party Integrations – Support for advanced integrations with other tools and plugins.
– 💬 Multi-style Support – Mix and match multiple design types on the same page.
– 🛠️ Premium Support – Get priority email support and help from our expert team.
– ⚡ All Free Features Included – The Pro version includes everything in the free version, plus much more!

How to Use

  1. Create a New Testimonial Section:

    • Once activated, go to your page or post where you want to add the testimonials.
    • Open Elementor to edit the page.
    • Look for the “User Testimonials” widget in the Elementor panel.
    • Drag and drop the widget onto the page.

  2. Select a Layout:

    • After placing the widget, you will see an array of pre-designed testimonial layouts.
    • Choose the layout you prefer.

  3. Add Testimonials:

    • For each testimonial, enter the customer’s name, image, testimonial content, and other details.
    • You can also add star ratings, client logos, and more, depending on the design you selected.

  4. Customize the Design:

    • Customize the font, color, and spacing settings to match your brand.
    • Adjust the layout’s alignment, border, and padding as needed.

  5. Save and Publish:

    • After making the necessary customizations, click “Save” or “Publish” to update your page.

Conclusion

User Testimonials is a powerful tool for anyone looking to add stylish and professional testimonial sections to their website. With over 14 beautiful layouts, customization options, and easy integration with Elementor, this plugin helps you build trust and showcase your success with customer reviews and testimonials.

Whether you’re running a personal blog, a business website, or an online store, customer testimonials are an excellent way to build credibility and boost conversions. Get started with User Testimonials today, and bring your testimonials to life in a way that captures your audience’s attention.

For any support or questions, feel free to reach out via our website or the WordPress support forum.

For more details on the license, please refer to the GPLv2 License.
sections.installation:
To install User Testimonials, follow these simple steps:

  1. Install via WordPress Admin:

    • Go to your WordPress dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
    • Search for “User Testimonials.”
    • Click “Install Now” and then activate the plugin.

  2. Install via FTP:

    • Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress plugin repository or from the official website.
    • Unzip the file.
    • Upload the extracted folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
    • Go to your WordPress admin panel and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
1. Is User Testimonials compatible with my theme?

    • Yes, User Testimonials is compatible with all WordPress themes, especially those using Elementor. However, it’s always a good practice to test the plugin on a staging site before implementing it on a live site.

  2. Do I need Elementor Pro to use this plugin?

    • No, you only need the free version of Elementor to use User Testimonials. It works seamlessly with both the free and pro versions of Elementor.

  3. Can I upgrade to the premium version?

    • Yes, the premium version of BWD Testimonials is available with advanced features. You can check out the premium version for more advanced customization options and additional layouts.

  4. How can I contact support?

    • If you need support, you can reach us through our official website or via the WordPress plugin support forum. We are happy to help resolve any issues you encounter.
